summary: Audited the Markdown for the task target L2:Schwann cell. Formal Schwann cell markers are NRXN (resolved to NRXN1) and XKR4 from snRNA-seq annotation, and NRXN1 from Xenium spatial annotation of nerve-associated Schwann cells. These were previously downgraded to cluster_enriched/context_only and are corrected to annotation_marker/include. DST:P3 is an isoform-level enrichment feature, not a formal marker, and is retained as context_only. All non-Schwann cell candidates (urothelial, smooth muscle, endothelial, pericyte, adipocyte, immune, fibroblast) are out of scope and excluded. The existing extraction required evidence-type, symbol, and cell-type corrections.

issues.description: Schwann cell markers NRXN (resolved to NRXN1) and XKR4 were previously classified as cluster_enriched/context_only, but the text uses them for cell annotation in 'Schwann cells (NRXN+/XKR4+)'; upgraded to annotation_marker and included.
Spatial NRXN1 evidence was listed under 'nerve cells (nerve bundle)' from Fig. S3E, but the main text describes the NRXN1+ cells as Schwann cells; corrected cell type to Schwann cells and included.
'NRXN' is ambiguous as a family symbol, but the paper uses NRXN and NRXN1 for the same Schwann-cell population (NRXN+/XKR4+ in snRNA-seq; NRXN1+ in Fig. S3E/main text); resolved NRXN to NRXN1.
DST:P3 is a poly(A) isoform feature enriched in Schwann cells, not a standard gene marker; retained as context_only with normalization_status non_gene_entity.
Numerous non-Schwann cell candidates (urothelial, smooth muscle, endothelial, pericyte, adipocyte, immune, and fibroblast markers) were excluded as outside the L2 Schwann cell scope.
No additional Schwann cell markers beyond NRXN/NRXN1 and XKR4 were found in the Markdown text or provided figures.
